Priya (CS): kicking off Nightingale Labs dedicated capacity bring-up. goal: stable p99 <200ms for chat + embeddings. customer-facing warmup window next Tue afternoon.
Darren (SRE): quick traffic calc: steady ~300 req/min, campaign spikes to ~1.2k/min. rough mapping -> ~8 GPUs sustained, ~14 GPUs peak with headroom.
Izzy (Infra): noted. recommend autoscale baseline: min 8, max 16. scale_up when p95_token_latency > 100ms for 120s; scale_down after 10m idle. also suggest prefix caching and longer KV retention for their workload.
Priya (CS): they asked for a deterministic warmup script that primes prefix caches and embeds store. can we define a concrete sequence?
Darren (SRE): warmup plan proposal: 3 stages:
1) Prefix replay: top-5k prompts replayed at 10 qps for 90m (primes KV + tokenizer caches).
2) Embedding bulk: 200k vectors in batches of 2k to exercise memory and IO.
3) Chat soak: ramp 0->peak over 20m, hold at peak 45m, then taper.
We'll capture GPU temp/util and token-level latencies.
Izzy (Infra): autoscale policy draft (putting as text to iterate):
```
{"scale_up_condition":"p95_latency>100ms for 120s","min_instances":8,"max_instances":16,"cooldown_down":600}
```
Apply conservative cooldowns during soak. tweak after first run.
Liam (Acct): FYI renewal in 8 months. if soak shows repeated p99 violations we'll surface as a renewal risk in QBR. also log any "model pinning" requests  potential upsell.
Priya (CS): good call. need a 30-min ops enablement runbook for their engineers (rollbacks, reading traces, emergency fallback). can someone own the deck?
Darren (SRE): I can do the demo. want to run it against real soak outputs, so schedule demo the day after soak.
Priya (CS): contact at Nightingale is @jane.nightingale (ops). I'll coordinate calendar invites after we lock soak time.
LoadBot: loadtest queued: job_id=load-1024-nightingale, spec=nightingale-soak-v2, start=2028-05-07T15:00Z
Darren (SRE): thanks bot. once job finishes paste raw latencies & gpu traces here. helper command:
```
./fetch_traces --job load-1024-nightingale --metrics p50,p95,p99,gpu_util > nightingale-traces.tar.gz
```
Priya (CS): schedule outline: soak Tue 15:00 UTC; enablement Wed 10:00 UTC; postmortem Thu 16:00 UTC. can everyone ack?
Izzy (Infra): ack.
Darren (SRE): ack.
Liam (Acct): ack.
Priya (CS): action items: 1) Darren run soak and paste traces (due Tue EOD). 2) Izzy finalize autoscale JSON and enable prefix cache + 6h KV retention. 3) Liam document renewal risk + upsell opportunities. 4) Priya run enablement and capture feedback.
Priya (CS): risk note: if p99 > 350ms during soak we will propose scaling to larger instance types or increasing reserved capacity  that impacts pricing. flagging for account negotiation. :warning:
Liam (Acct): will loop in finance/legal after soak if we need a contract amendment.
Priya (CS): thanks team 44d will post traces and customer feedback here when available.
